title: Be seen with a Sunflower
summary: Learn about the Hidden Disabilities Sunflower program and how it helps people with invisible disabilities receive support at Service NSW.
intro:
The Hidden Disabilities Sunflower program aims to empower those living with hidden disability, by making the invisible, visible, through the Sunflower symbol.

People can voluntarily choose to wear a Sunflower product such as a lanyard, wristband or pin, to indicate that they may require additional time, support or understanding. A hidden or invisible disability may include neurological, cognitive and neurodevelopment, physical, visual, auditory, sensory and processing difficulties.

Team members in our service centres are trained to recognise the Sunflower symbol.

We encourage customers who need assistance to look out for our team members wearing a Sunflower supporter pin.

faqs.q: What is the Hidden Disabilities Sunflower program?
faqs.a: The program helps make invisible disabilities visible by using the Sunflower symbol. People can wear a Sunflower product to indicate they may require additional time, support, or understanding.

faqs.q: What types of disabilities can be considered hidden or invisible?
faqs.a: Hidden or invisible disabilities may include neurological, cognitive and neurodevelopment, physical, visual, auditory, sensory and processing difficulties.

faqs.q: How can I get assistance at Service NSW?
faqs.a: Customers who need assistance are encouraged to look out for team members wearing a Sunflower supporter pin, as the staff are trained to recognize the symbol.
